samples.question: The picture shows one solid plate of a single flat colour on white paper. Four round white chambers are cut into the plate. Narrow straight white channels are also cut into the plate: a channel joins two chambers, or runs from a chamber to the outside of the plate. Some channels are crossed by a short bar of plate colour that spans the channel completely and blocks it. A chamber counts as OPEN if you can travel from inside that chamber to the white paper outside the plate while staying on white the whole way, moving only through chambers and unblocked channels and never crossing any plate colour. A chamber counts as SEALED otherwise. Travelling through other chambers on the way is allowed. How many of the four chambers are SEALED? Answer with a number from 0 to 4.
